text: dsh-pptx-sidebar 是面向 DSH Web 侧栏的演示文稿阅读插件，依赖 dsh-better-sidebar 注册文件预览器，可打开 PPTX 和 PPTM。它按演示文稿指定的顺序展示幻灯片，并提取段落文字、项目符号层级、标题、演讲者备注、表格和内嵌图片；用户可在侧栏逐页阅读。阅读视图会根据侧栏宽度调整文字排版，并为大型或异常压缩的文件设置读取上限。它不重现原始版式，也不处理母版继承、动画或编辑写回；没有额外 API Key 配置。

dsh-pptx-sidebar adds a DSH sidebar viewer for PPTX/PPTM through dsh-better-sidebar. It shows slides in deck order with text, bullets, notes, tables, and pictures. Text adapts to the sidebar. It does not reproduce layouts or resolve master inheritance.
想在 DSH 侧栏直接阅读 PPTX 幻灯片内容。
希望按演示文稿原本的顺序浏览幻灯片，而不是按文件名排序。
需要从演示文稿里查看正文、项目符号和演讲者备注。
想在 DSH 里预览 PPTM 文件中的幻灯片和图片。
I want to read presentation slides in the DSH sidebar without opening a full slide editor.
Show me the deck’s speaker notes and embedded pictures while I browse slides in order.
dsh-pptx-sidebar 的功能「侧栏幻灯片阅读」：在 DSH 的侧栏预览区打开 PPTX/PPTM，按演示文稿顺序展示幻灯片，并提供逐页浏览界面。
dsh-pptx-sidebar 的功能「提取演示内容」：读取幻灯片文字、项目符号层级、演讲者备注、表格和内嵌图片，供用户在阅读视图查看。
dsh-pptx-sidebar 的功能「自适应阅读排版」：随侧栏宽度调整文字尺寸和换行，让幻灯片内容适合窄栏阅读。
dsh-pptx-sidebar 使用前须知：需要 dsh-better-sidebar 的 betterSidebar 服务；缺少时预览器不活动。母版或布局继承的文字不会显示。
想把演示文稿中的备注和内嵌图片一并放在侧栏查看。
Let me browse PPTX slides and their extracted text in a narrow sidebar.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · dsh-pptx-sidebar：[简体中文](README.md) | [Français](README.fr.md) | [Deutsch](README.de.md) | [Italiano](README.it.md) | [Русский](README.ru.md) | [Español](README.es.md)

> ⛔ **本项目已停止维护（2026-10-01）。** DSH 宿主较新版本已内置 office 演示文稿的侧栏预览，本插件不再单独维护、不再发版，也不参与后续宿主版本线适配。已发布版本仍可安装使用；0.1.x 宿主请使用冻结分支 `compat/0.1.7` / `compat/0.1.5` 的对应版本。

Read `.pptx` / `.pptm` decks in the DSH sidebar — the slides **in presentation
order**, with their text, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · dsh-pptx-sidebar：> **This is a reading view, not a slide reproduction.** No absolute positioning,
> no theme fonts, no placeholder inheritance, no animation. The viewer says so in
> its header, because a layout difference that looks like a rendering bug is
> worse than a plainly-labelled limitation.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · dsh-pptx-sidebar：It is a [dsh-better-sidebar](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-sidebar)
consumer: it registers a file previewer and renders inside the Side card's
preview area. Without that plugin it loads, warns once, and does nothing.

---

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:drscrewdriver/dsh-pptx-sidebar#<sha>
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-pptx-sidebar@0.1.0     # once published
```

Then **restart the DSH host** — a browser refresh is not enough for a new loader
row. Verify without starting anything:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | Select-String dsh-pptx-sidebar
```

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Install：Manual installation is three steps, not one — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Doing only
steps 1 and 3 produces a profile where the package is present, the patch row is
present, **and nothing loads, silently**.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · What it does / does not do：| Done | Not done |
|------|----------|
| Slide list in `p:sldIdLst` order | Visual layout, absolute positioning |
| Text paragraphs, per-paragraph bullet levels | Theme/master font resolution |
| Title detection from placeholder type | **Placeholder inheritance** (see below) |
| Speaker notes from `notesSlide` parts | Charts re-rendered as charts |
| Inline pictures as blob URLs | Animation, transitions, timings |
| Real tables (`a:tbl`) | Comments, revision marks |
| Bold / italic runs | Editing, writing back |
| Seven circuit-breaker ceilings | Legacy `.ppt` (BIFF/OLE2), WPS formats |
section: What it does / does not do

text:
dsh-pptx-sidebar README · The placeholder inheritance line (deliberate)：A slide often shows text it does not contain: numbers, footers, and title text
that live in `slideLayout` / `slideMaster`, referenced through a `p:ph`
placeholder. Resolving that means re-implementing PowerPoint's inheritance chain
— including `lstStyle` level overrides and which layout the slide actually uses.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · The placeholder inheritance line (deliberate)：**v1 does not do it.** Only the slide's own part is read. The consequence is
stated rather than hidden: a slide whose text is entirely inherited renders with
no text. That is a visible omission, not a corruption — the opposite trade
(inheriting wrongly) would show text that is not on the slide.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Width adaptation：The sidebar pane is resizable, so the reading view adapts to it — within bounds,
because "adaptive" is not a licence to keep growing or shrinking:

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Width adaptation：| Knob | Value | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| Base width | 360 px | The factor is **exactly 1** here, so the usual pane width renders the layout 0.1.0 shipped |
| Floor | 0.9× | A narrow pane still gets readable type |
| Ceiling | 1.15× | A wide pane gets comfortable type, not enormous type |
| Quantisation | 2 decimals | A drag re-lays-out on 0.01 steps, not on every pixel |

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Width adaptation：The factor is derived from the pane width and written to the `--reader-scale`
custom property; the root font-size becomes `13px × scale` and the slide content
is expressed in `em`, so text **reflows** at the new size instead of being
transform-scaled (which would blur glyphs).

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Width adaptation：**Only the document scales.** Titles, bullets, paragraphs, notes, tables and
image captions follow the factor; the header strip, the slide strip, the breaker
banner and the loading/empty states keep their fixed size. Chrome that changes
size while you drag a divider reads as a glitch rather than as responsiveness.

Two related decisions:

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Width adaptation：- **An unmeasurable width falls back to 1**, not to a bound. Before the first
  measurement the width is 0, and rendering that as "as narrow as possible" would
  flash tiny type every time a deck is opened.
- **Pictures do not scale.** They render at the size the shape transform states
  and are only capped by the pane; magnifying a bitmap past its natural size to
  track the text would make it softer, not more faithful.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · The pipeline：```
archive bytes (host /sidebar/file, custom loader)
  → archive-size gate                      refuse before any unpacking
  → central directory (declared-size gate) refuse a lying part before inflating
  → streaming inflate + total budget       the zip-bomb gate

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · The pipeline：Pictures are pulled out of the zip and turned into object URLs. An embedded image
lives *inside* the archive, so there is no host route to point at — this is not
"reading files ourselves", it is using the bytes the host already handed over.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Seven circuit-breaker ceilings：| Dimension | Default | Over it |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| Archive size | 8 MB | BLOCKED — refused before any unpacking |
| Total inflate | 64 MB | BLOCKED — the zip-bomb gate |
| One part | 32 MB | BLOCKED — a single oversized XML part |
| Slides | 300 | TRUNCATED — the reader stops walking the deck |
| Slide text | 20 000 chars | that slide's remaining text elided |
| Images | 200 | further pictures skipped |
| One image | 8 MB | that picture skipped (not even inflated) |

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Seven circuit-breaker ceilings：**At most one warning per dimension**, structurally — warnings live in a
`Map<reason, warning>`, so a dimension that trips on every slide produces one
line, not sixty.

The per-slide text ceiling elides only the offending slide. A per-block ceiling
would shave every slide equally and lose information the deck had budget for; the
failure mode we accept instead is "slide 12 is cut short".

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Tests：```bash
npm install
npm run verify          # build (bundle load gate) + tests
npm test                # 19 checks
```

The fixture is a real pptx-shaped zip built in the test file, with a genuine
tiny PNG. It is hostile where the format is:

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Layout：| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `pptx.ts` | The reader: parts, relationships, shape tree, notes, pictures |
| `circuit-breaker.ts` | The seven ceilings and the single-warning-per-dimension rule |
| `zip.ts` / `xml.ts` | Container reading; targeted XML scanning with depth counting |
| `PptxViewer.tsx` | Slide strip, current-slide rendering, object-URL lifetime |
| `locales.ts` | zh / en dictionaries, including every warning template |
| `seams.ts` | Structural mirrors of the client services we consume |

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Layout：The zip and XML code is **copied** from the sibling document plugin rather than
shared. Two users of this code is not yet the threshold for extracting a package
— that would add a third thing to publish and version-lock.

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Compatibility：| Plugin version | DSH host range | Notes |
|----------------|----------------|-------|
| 0.3.0 | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1-0` | The 0.2.0 line (`main`, promoted from `compat/0.2.0`). Metadata-only adaptation: the consumption surface is pure `ctx.get(...)` calls, 0.2.0-rc.1 keeps the 0.1.7 plugin API intact |
| 0.2.0 | `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0-0` | Served by the frozen branches `compat/0.1.7` / `compat/0.1.5` |

dsh-pptx-sidebar README · Compatibility：`engines.dsh`, the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` peer in `package.json`, and
`dsh.plugin.json`'s `engines.dsh` all carry the same range (kept in lockstep).
